After the offered fee cut, the hypothetical marginal $75m inception commitment has +$2.82m NPV.Negotiated improvements could increase this value, but they are not yet secured.

The workbook's −$2.82m is the NPVchange from reducing. The value ofretaining the extra commitmentis +$2.82m.
20% annual asset growth; 15% discount rate; hypothetical inception model. This is not a December valuation of cancelling remaining obligations.
All values scale the $750m model by 10%, holding fund size, investment timing and proportional cash-flow rights fixed.
